body: One beat, 38 songs, and almost 2 BILLION combined streams 🤯🔥 You’ve probably heard the Coolie Dance Rhythm more times than you realize. Created by Jamaican producer Cordel “Scatta” Burrell, it connects songs like Nina Sky’s “Move Ya Body,” Pitbull’s “Culo,” Kehlani’s “After Hours,” and KAROL G, Judeline and rusowsky’s “BBY WOW.” 🇯🇲 For more than 20 years, artists have continued reimagining the rhythm, bringing their own sound to it and introducing it to new generations. Those familiar hits are part of a much bigger story spanning 38 songs. Spotify’s SongDNA lets you explore the samples, writers, producers and musical connections behind your favorite tracks including the shared roots of songs you might never have connected. 👀 Which song did you hear this beat in first? 👇
